question: If $\begin{vmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{vmatrix}=7$, find $\begin{vmatrix}a+3c&b+3d\\c&d\end{vmatrix}$ without expansion.
explanation:
Step 1: Observe the row operation
The first row of the original determinant has been replaced by the sum of the first row and three times the second row.
Step 2: Identify the property
The value of a determinant remains unchanged under the operation $$R_1\to R_1+kR_2$$
Step 3: Apply the property
Here, the operation is $R_1\to R_1+3R_2$. Therefore, $$\begin{vmatrix}a+3c&b+3d\\c&d\end{vmatrix}=\begin{vmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 4: Use the given value
Hence, the required determinant is $7$.
